claim: Every non-root source configuration within the declared full six-dimensional center box has polarization strictly below the enclosed symmetric KKT root value.
method: exact-rational two-cone Taylor bound: active-gradient linear separation away from the critical space and uniform negative weighted envelope curvature near it
logical_summary: If an active-gradient difference is large, one branch decreases linearly and dominates every quadratic Taylor remainder.
If all differences are small, pivot elimination places the direction close to the critical graph, where the weighted envelope Hessian is uniformly negative.
The two cases cover every nonzero source displacement in the declared box.
scope_warning: This is a quantitative local cap for global branch-and-bound. It still does not exclude better configurations outside the box.
